description: The splash-screen chips, asked live. Each page is scored for its writing (as in page-quality) and for what a visitor can do with it: cards with nothing to play on the page (silent), collapsed show rows whose More opens to nothing (empty_rows), and text blocks that retell cards already on the page (restated). The questions match OPENING_QUESTIONS in scripts/warm_answers.py and the startingPoints list in web/src/App.tsx. Run with: PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/page_eval.py --suite evals/opening-v1.json. See docs/OPENING-QUESTIONS-ROADMAP.md.
